definitions.explanation: A child roughly between the ages of 1 and 6, from the time they can walk until they enter elementary school. In Japanese law and education, {幼児|ようじ} specifically refers to children from age 1 to school entry.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a picture book for young children.

examples.japanese: {幼児|ようじ}{教育|きょういく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The importance of early childhood education is getting attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プール→プール：02958_puuru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{幼児|ようじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This pool has a shallow area where even toddlers can play safely.

notes:
USAGE:
Distinguish from related age terms: ⟦{乳児|にゅうじ}→乳児：11414_nyuuji⟧ (infant, under 1 year), {幼児|ようじ} (toddler/young child, roughly 1-6), ⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ (child, elementary school age). {幼児|ようじ} is a slightly formal or official term; in everyday conversation, ⟦{小|ちい}さい→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (small child) is more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {幼児|ようじ}{教育|きょういく}: early childhood education
- {幼児|ようじ}{向|む}け: aimed at young children
- {幼児|ようじ}{期|き}: early childhood period
- {幼児|ようじ}⟦{虐待|ぎゃくたい}→虐待：14046_gyakutai⟧: child abuse (of young children)
